Files: pdf.min.js, pdf.worker.min.js (unmodified copies of build/pdf.min.js and build/pdf.worker.min.js from the npm package pdfjs-dist@3.11.174), LICENSE.
Used only by the administrator's certificate calibration preview in the Immersive ELT Design Lab portal.
Both files are loaded as ordinary scripts (the worker code then runs on the main thread), so no cross-origin Worker is created.
